text:
State of Play | September 3, 2026 [English Subtitles]
State of Play returns Thursday, September 3 with two broadcasts airing back-to-back.

First, tune in for a new State of Play featuring updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and our third-party partners, concluding with an extended look at the vast world of Final Fantasy VII Revelation from our friends at Square Enix.

Immediately following, stay tuned for a new episode of State of Play Japan, once again hosted by Yuki Kaji. State of Play Japan will offer deep dives into upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, including new gameplay, announcements, and more.

Watch both broadcasts live on September 3 starting at 6:00am PT / 9:00am ET / 3:00pm CEST / 10:00pm JST on YouTube and Twitch. State of Play will air in English, with Japanese subtitles also available. State of Play Japan will air in Japanese, with English subtitles available.

See you there.
Regarding co-streaming and video-on-demand (VOD)

Please note that this broadcast may include copyrighted content (e.g. licensed music) that Sony Interactive Entertainment does not control. We welcome and celebrate our amazing co-streamers and creators, but licensing agreements outside our control could interfere with co-streams or VOD archives of this broadcast. If you’re planning to save this broadcast as a VOD to create recap videos, or to repost clips or segments from the show, we advise omitting any copyrighted music.

Introducing Live TV on PS5
Starting later today, Live TV on PS5® by Sony Pictures will be available to PS5® players in the U.S., bringing more than 100 live channels and a growing selection of on-demand entertainment directly to the Media section of PS5®.

Discover movies, TV shows, anime, sports, news, creator-led programming and more — free with ads and no subscription required.

To get started, head to the Media tab on your PS5® console and select Live TV on PS5®.

Learn more: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/live-tv-on-ps5
Programming availability may vary by local TV markets and may change over time.

text:
MXGP 26: The Official Game - Pre-order Trailer | PS5 Games
MXGP 26 - The Official Game releases October 1, 2026 on PS5®. Preorder now: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015195

Thanks to the transition to Unreal Engine 5, MXGP 26 achieves a historic visual milestone. With top riders such as Jeffrey Herlings, Lucas Coenen and Tim Gajser, MXGP 26 is your go to!

Experience fully rewritten motorcycle physics, and completely reworked rider animations and the terrain in MXGP 26 is now alive. Dynamic deformation technology alters the track as riders pass through.

Official 2026 season content in the spotlight! Here are the details below!

· Iconic Tracks: Including Bariloche in Argentina (volcanic soil), Riola Sardo in Sardinia (sand), Pietramurata in Italy (compact dirt), and Loket in the Czech Republic (hard-pack dirt).

· Elite Riders: Across both MXGP and MX2 categories, players will find stars of the sport such as Jeffrey Herlings, Lucas Coenen and Tim Gajser, Romain Febvre, Maxime Renaux, Kay de Wolf, and Calvin Vlaanderen.

· Full Customization: A comprehensive editor allows players to design their rider and customize official machines from championship manufacturers (Kawasaki, Husqvarna, Yamaha, KTM, Honda…) with gear from leading brands (Fox Racing, Alpinestars, Scott, Airoh, etc.)

Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Pre-order Trailer | PS5 Games
Gear.Club Unlimited 3 is Gear.Club Unlimited 3 is releasing October 9, 2026! Preorder now: https://store.playstation.com/product/EP6665-PPSA33917_00-GCU3000000000000/

It's time to make the engine roar. Discover the first gameplay footage of Gear.Club Unlimited 3!

For the first time, Gear.Club arrives in Japan. The Story Mode will take you on a journey between Japan and the French Mediterranean Coast in search of the best drivers to share the love of car culture.

Also, discover the new game modes:
- Highway Rush: Put your reflexes to the test as you race at full speed through traffic on crowded highways.
- Duel: Go head-to-head with your rivals to prove your supremacy.

This first look also reveals the customization options to create the car of your dreams in a garage designed to your liking, as well as the split-screen multiplayer mode for wild games with friends.

So, ready to join the Club?
